description: Run the REAL Argus engine battery (canonical S8 + fault scenarios) against a LIVE agent endpoint using paid quota. Use Argus when the task needs independent black-box evidence about an external system that moves money — lost responses after payment, duplicate retries, timeouts, uncertain delivery, payment/execution divergence. Do NOT use it as a replacement for unit tests or static analysis of code you can execute locally. Free entry: every new account gets 3 welcome engine runs (+30-run beta pack), and a run that fails the canonical payment gate is refunded in full (net cost 0) — until the agent passes the gate, you pay nothing. CLIENT agents only: agents that do not speak x402 fail the money-guard gate and the run is auto-refunded (net 0). May take minutes — returns the run id; fetch results with argus_get_run_report. Run argus_run_simulation first if unsure.

battery.description: Optional battery id; defaults to the role's starter battery
